name: Advanced Toolbar Visibility Manager – Hide/Disable Admin Bar, Remove Toolbar Logo, Customize Toolbar, Disable Frontend Toolbar, Move Toolbar to Bottom
author: akashahmed29

sections.description:
Advanced Toolbar Visibility Manager gives WordPress administrators complete control over who sees the admin toolbar. Perfect for customizing user experiences across different roles while maintaining security and clean interfaces.

🔧 Key Features:
– Show/hide toolbar for any user role with one click
– Customize admin bar appearance and behavior
– Improve frontend user experience by removing unnecessary clutter
– Advanced settings for power users with import/export functionality

🌟 Why Choose This Plugin?
– Lightweight and optimized for performance
– Intuitive interface – no coding required
– Compatible with all major themes and plugins
– Regular updates with new features

🔥 FEATURES

👤 Subscribers – Clean up the interface for basic members

✍️ Contributors – Simplify the view for content contributors

📝 Authors – Customize visibility for post creators

✏️ Editors – Tailor the toolbar for your editorial team

⚙️ Administrators – Always maintain full control for admins

🙅 Disable Frontend Bar – Remove the admin bar sitewide

👥 Hide for Logged-In – Clean interface for all members

👻 Hide for Guests – Present a pure frontend to visitors

🔇 Hide WP Icon – Remove the WordPress logo

🖼️ Upload Custom Logo – Add your brand mark

🔗 Custom Logo Link – Redirect to your homepage

⬆️ Top/Bottom Position – Choose where it floats

🌈 Background Type – Solid or gradient colors

🎨 Color Picker – Customize backgrounds/text

🗂 Dropdown Styles – Modernize menu appearance

🔘 Button Colors – Match your brand palette

⚡ Auto-Save – Changes apply instantly

📤 Export Config – Backup your setup

📥 Import Settings – Migrate between sites

🔄 Reset Defaults – Revert with one click
sections.installation:
1. Install the Plugin:

    • Navigate to WordPress Dashboard → Plugins → Add New
    • Search for “Toolbar Visibility Manager”
    • Click “Install Now” then “Activate”

  2. Configure Settings:

    • Go to Settings → Toolbar Visibility Manager
    • Adjust visibility for each user role
    • Customize appearance as needed
    • Save your changes

  3. Verify:

    • Test different user accounts to confirm settings
sections.faq:
Does this work with all WordPress themes?

✅ Yes, the plugin is compatible with all standard WordPress themes. Some page builders might require additional CSS for perfect integration.

Can I set different colors for different user roles?

Currently, color settings apply globally across all user roles. Role-specific styling may be added in future updates.
